start.title: [TODO:de] Setting Out
start.text:
[TODO:de] Evening falls on the sea.
Jesus says, "Let us cross over."

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Follow His Word
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His call is for tonight.
Go with him.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Trust Him Now
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He waits at the shore.
Delay nothing.

storm.title: [TODO:de] The Sea Rises
storm.text:
[TODO:de] Wind tears the sail.
Waves crash into the boat.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Hold Steady
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Cursing will not still the storm.
Row with the others.

leap_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Stay With Him
leap_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The sea would swallow you.
Return to the boat.

sleep.title: [TODO:de] He Sleeps
sleep.text:
[TODO:de] Jesus sleeps in the stern.
The storm grows fiercer.

alone_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Go To Him
alone_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] You cannot save the boat alone.
Wake your Lord.

wake.title: [TODO:de] Wake Him
wake.text:
[TODO:de] What will you say?
The water rises fast.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Ask, Don't Blame
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] He is not your enemy.
Ask him to save you.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Cry To Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Silence will not still the sea.
Speak.

calm.title: [TODO:de] Peace, Be Still
calm.text:
[TODO:de] He stands and lifts his hand.
"Peace. Be still."

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:de] See and Believe
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The sea is glass.
Let awe fill you.

amaze.title: [TODO:de] Who Is This?
amaze.text:
[TODO:de] The sea is still.
"Even the wind obeys him."
